description: Client-side script for the 'Packing Slip' doctype in ERPNext, handling form queries, validation, and calculations related to packing slips.

methods.name: cur_frm.fields_dict['delivery_note'].get_query
methods.description: Defines query filters for selecting delivery notes with docstatus 0.

methods.name: cur_frm.fields_dict['items'].grid.get_field('item_code').get_query
methods.description: Defines query for item_code field, requiring a selected delivery note.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.onload_post_render
methods.description: On form load, fetches items if delivery note exists and form is new.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.get_items
methods.description: Calls server method 'get_items' to retrieve item details.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.refresh
methods.description: Toggles display of 'misc_details' based on 'amended_from' field.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.validate
methods.description: Performs validation on form before save, including case number validation and item detail calculations.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.validate_case_nos
methods.description: Validates that 'From Package No.' is >= 1 and 'To Package No.' >= 'From Package No.'.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.validate_calculate_item_details
methods.description: Validates duplicate items and calculates total net weight.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.validate_duplicate_items
methods.description: Checks for duplicate item codes and non-positive quantities.

methods.name: cur_frm.cscript.calc_net_total_pkg
methods.description: Calculates total net weight of the package, ensuring consistent UOM.
